lead_raw_text:
The structure of DyHf(CuO2)2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 8 atoms and 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Dy and Hf each coordinated by 8 O neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Cu centers have 4 O neighbors and O centers have 3 geometric neighbors (1 Cu, 2 Dy, or 1 Cu, 1 Dy, 1 Hf). Corner-sharing is observed between Dy and Hf 8-vertex polyhedra, between Dy and O polyhedra, and between Cu 4-vertex polyhedra.
